prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A hyper-detailed macro close-up of the intricate inner workings of a luxury mechanical watch. The composition focuses on polished metallic gears, screws, and bridges, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background and edges, drawing attention to the sharp, gleaming surfaces of the components. The color palette features a harmonious blend of gold, brass, and steel tones, accented by cool blue and teal reflections that suggest ambient, diffused lighting. Subtle highlights and soft shadows create a sense of depth and dimensionality, while the overall mood is one of precision, craftsmanship, and sophistication. The image has a cinematic quality, reminiscent of high-end product photography or a dramatic film close-up, with a slight vignette that further emphasizes the central mechanical details.
